data.title: The Portuguese Cork Association Brings "Drink Responsibly. Choose a Bottle with a Natural Cork" Campaign to New York City with Experiential Pedicab Program
data.description: A new initiative is providing complimentary pedicab rides to professionals and customers in the wine industry in order to encourage responsible drinking at major wine events in the city. The campaign kicks off with Wine on Wheels, with the Portuguese Cork Association (APCOR) leading the charge to educate about sustainable practices. This move is part of APCOR's broader effort to underscore the importance of responsible wine consumption.

data.title: EQB Inc. Appoints Vivian Abdelmessih to the Board of Directors
data.description: Kishore Kapoor, the present Board member of EQB and Chair of the Risk & Capital Committee, will be resigning from his position starting January 1, 2027. The announcement was made by the Board of Directors of EQB Inc. and Equitable Bank on October 16, 2026. They are to appoint Vivian to take over Kapoor's role.

data.title: UL Solutions Warns of GFCI and Duplex Wall Outlets Modified by Third Parties to Include Built-in Cameras
data.description: UL Solutions, a prominent company in safety science, recently released a statement about UL Certified ground fault circuit interrupter (GFCI) and duplex wall outlets. These products, manufactured by original companies and bearing the UL Mark, have been altered by third parties to incorporate hidden cameras into their design. UL Solutions highlighted that these modified outlets have not undergone evaluation by the company and are not authorized to display the UL Mark. This notice serves as a warning to consumers about the potential risks associated with using such modified products.

data.title: Port Houston Regular Commission Meeting
data.description: The Port Commission of the Port of Houston Authority is scheduled to convene its Regular Monthly Meeting on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, commencing at 9:15 a.m. The meeting will take place at 2960 Riverby Road, Houston, TX 77020, within the boardroom of the Port Houston Authority Administrative Building. It will be a hybrid meeting, allowing both in-person attendance and virtual participation via Microsoft Teams Townhall. Interested individuals can join to discuss important matters related to the port's operations.

data.title: Granite REIT Declares Distribution for October 2026
data.description: In Toronto, Granite Real Estate Investment Trust (TSX: GRT.UN) revealed that its board of trustees has approved a distribution of CDN $0.2958 per unit for October 2026. The distribution is scheduled to be disbursed on November 16, 2026, to unitholders recorded at the end of trading on October 30, 2026. It was emphasized that none of the distribution is considered effectively connected income for U.S. federal tax purposes. Additionally, a qualified notice will be provided.

data.title: Oldcastle BuildingEnvelope Strategically Aligns Glass Manufacturing Network
data.description: In Dallas, Oldcastle BuildingEnvelope (OBE) revealed a strategic shift in its glass manufacturing network aimed at consolidating operations in pivotal regional sites to enhance capabilities and better cater to changing market demands. This initiative involves transitioning glass operations from its Miami South, Florida, and Grand Prairie, Texas facilities to existing regional facilities with adequate capacity, expertise, and resources. This move aims to optimize resources to support customers effectively as market dynamics shift.

data.title: Greenberg Traurig's Michael J. Bonner Honored by Las Vegas Regional Economic Partnership
data.description: On October 16th, 2026, Michael J. Bonner, the co-managing shareholder of the Las Vegas branch of international law firm Greenberg Traurig, LLP, received the Distinguished Leadership Award from the Las Vegas Regional Economic Partnership (LVREP). This award is a prestigious recognition within the Las Vegas business community. The LVREP, previously known as the Las Vegas Regional Chamber of Commerce, bestowed this honor to Bonner in acknowledgment of his outstanding leadership and contributions to the region's economic landscape.

data.title: Illinois American Water Announces 2026 "Water Keeps Life Flowing" Art Contest
data.description: Belleville, Illinois - On October 16, 2026, a grade school contest was held by Illinois American Water to highlight the importance of high-quality water systems in students' everyday activities. The contest aimed to raise awareness among students by inviting them to demonstrate their creativity through artwork submissions. The initiative, called "Water Keeps Life," encouraged students to showcase their understanding of the vital role water plays in their lives. This event was organized to emphasize the significance of clean water and its impact on daily routines.

data.title: ASSA ABLOY sells PKI business unit to Vista Equity Partners
data.description: In Stockholm on October 16, 2026, ASSA ABLOY announced the sale of HID's PKI business unit to Vista Equity Partners. The PKI business unit, specializing in digital trust, identity, authentication, encryption, and certificate management, was acquired by Vista Equity Partners through the agreement. This strategic move signifies a significant development in the digital security sector, with key focus on public key infrastructure.

data.title: Heytea Opens Its First U.S. Gelato Lab+ in New York
data.description: Heytea, known for revolutionizing tea culture, is now introducing eight unique gelato and sorbet flavors made in-store. The brand, which continues to redefine the tea experience, is expanding its offerings beyond traditional teas. This development comes as Heytea continues to push the boundaries of what tea can be. The flavors are all crafted in-house and are set to bring a fresh twist to the world of desserts. This innovation marks a significant step for the company as it diversifies its product range. The move signals Heytea's commitment to remaining at the forefront of creating inventive tea-based products. Customers can now enjoy a range of tea-infused gelato and sorbet options at Heytea's locations.

data.title: Bank of America Declares Preferred Stock Dividends Payable in November and December 2026
data.description: In a recent announcement, Bank of America Corporation, based in Charlotte, N.C., revealed that its Board of Directors has given authorization for regular cash dividends to be paid out on outstanding shares or depositary shares of specific series of preferred stock. The dividend per share for each series of preferred stock was also specified in the disclosure. This signifies a significant financial move by the corporation, demonstrating its commitment to providing returns to its shareholders. The specifics of the dividends indicate a continued focus on rewarding investors, promoting stability in the market, and enhancing overall investor confidence.

data.title: The NXG Cushing® Midstream Energy Fund Announces Fund Name Change
data.description: On October 16, 2026, in Dallas, the NXG Cushing® Midstream Energy Fund (NYSE: SRV) disclosed alterations in its name and non-fundamental investment policies authorized by the Board of Trustees. These modifications will come into effect on December 18.

data.title: Akara Partners and Deven Group Close Financing on 305-Bed Class A Student Housing Development at San Diego State University
data.description: A collaborative effort between development partners will bring forth the construction of a transit-oriented development at 5077 College Avenue, located near the SDSU campus core. This project is expected to be completed by the 2028-2029 academic year. Akara Partners, a real estate investment, development, and operating firm, is involved in this initiative. This development aims to cater to the needs of the university community and enhance the area's infrastructure.
